resources.string: Sibala ukuthi isikrini ngasinye nesenzo ngasinye sisetshenziswa kangaki, sisebenzisa i-Google Analytics for Firebase. Kuthunyelwa kuphela igama lesikrini nohlobo lwesenzo — hhayi neze iziteshi noma amavidiyo owabukayo, amanothi akho, noma ama-URL owafakayo. Asisebenzisi isihlonzi sezikhangiso. Ungakuvala ngezansi noma nini.

Ukudlala okuzenzakalelayo kuvuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo: uma ividiyo iphela, ukudlala kuqhubekela kuvidiyo elandelayo ohlwini lwesiteshi olivulile. Kudlulela kuphela kuvidiyo elandelayo kulolo hlu — hhayi neze kumavidiyo ahlobene noma anconywayo. Ungakuvala noma nini ngenkinobho yokushintsha ethi “Ukudlala okuzenzakalelayo” esikrinini sesidlali; bese ukudlala kuyama uma ividiyo iphela futhi kuvele inkinobho ethi “Dlala ividiyo elandelayo”. Ukukhetha kwakho kulondolozwa kudivayisi futhi kugcinwa uma i-app ibuyekezwa. Akukho ukudlala ngemuva, ngakho ukuvala i-app kumisa kokubili ukudlala nokudlala okuzenzakalelayo.
Ukudlala okuzenzakalelayo (kuvuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, kuvale noma nini)
Uhlu lwamavidiyo luvela ku-YouTube Data API v3. Ukudlala kushumeka isidlali esisemthethweni se-YouTube njengoba sinjalo. Akukho ukukhuhla idatha (scraping) futhi akukho sidlali sangokwezifiso.
Le app akuyona i-app esemthethweni ye-YouTube.
Ukudlala kusebenzisa isidlali esishumekiwe esisemthethweni se-YouTube (IFrame Player).

Indawo yokudlala yevidiyo ngayinye ilondolozwa kudivayisi, ngakho uma uvula ividiyo futhi iqhubeka lapho ugcine khona (kuvuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo). Ungakuvala kumenyu ethi “…” esikrinini sesidlali, futhi okuthi “Dlala kusukela ekuqaleni” kubuyela ekuqaleni. Kulondolozwa kuphela indawo ngamasekhondi — hhayi neze ividiyo uqobo.

Ngenkathi ividiyo idlala isikrini sihlala sivulekile, ngakho ngeke sifiphale sikuphazamise uma idivayisi ibekwe etafuleni. Uma umisa isikhashana noma ushiya isidlali, ukukhiya okuzenzakalelayo kubuyela esimweni esijwayelekile. Akukho ukudlala ngemuva, ngakho ukuvala i-app kumisa ukudlala.

Umsizi wokubuka obonisa amavidiyo esiteshi ngokosuku lokushicilelwa (okudala kuqala) ukuze ukwazi ukuqeda ingobo yomlando, uchungechunge, noma izifundo ngenkathi ulandelela inqubekelaphambili yakho. Akuyona into ethatha indawo ye-app esemthethweni ye-YouTube.
Setha i-YOUTUBE_API_KEY ku-Config.plist. Bheka i-README ukuze ubone ukuthi uyisetha kanjani.
Asitholanga isixhumanisi se-YouTube ebhodini lokunamathisela. Namathisela i-URL bese uzama futhi.
Le app akuyona i-app esemthethweni ye-YouTube. Ukudlala kusebenzisa isidlali esishumekiwe esisemthethweni se-YouTube; ayilandi amavidiyo, ayivimbi izikhangiso, futhi ayidlali ngemuva.
Umkhawulo we-YouTube API ufinyelelwe. Sicela uzame futhi emuva kwesikhashana.
Asikwazanga ukulayisha uhlu lwamavidiyo lwalesi siteshi.
Ukususa lesi siteshi kuphinde kususe umlando wokubuka, inqubekelaphambili, namanothi ka-“%s”.
Swayiphela umugqa kwesokunxele ukuze uwususe. Ukususa kuphinde kususe umlando wokubuka, inqubekelaphambili, namanothi alesi siteshi.
Sebenzisa inkinobho yomgqomo ukuze ukhiphe isiteshi kokulondoloziwe. Ukusikhipha kuphinde kususe umlando waso wokubuka, inqubekelaphambili, namanothi.
Yabelana usuka ku-app ye-YouTube noma ku-Safari bese ukhetha “%s” — bese kuvela okuthi “Vula isixhumanisi okwabelwane ngaso” kulesi sikrini. Kusebenza kokubili ama-URL eziteshi namavidiyo.
Yabelana usuka ku-app ye-YouTube noma kusiphequluli bese ukhetha “%s” — uhlu lwamavidiyo lwesiteshi luvuleka ngokushesha. Kusebenza kokubili ama-URL eziteshi namavidiyo.
Imibhalo engezansi yale vidiyo ayikalayishwa. Qala ukudlala, bese uvula leli phepha futhi (amanye amavidiyo awanayo imibhalo engezansi).

I-YouTube ilungisa ikhwalithi ngokuzenzakalelayo ngokuya ngoxhumano lwakho (isidlali esisemthethweni asivumeli ama-app ukuthi ayisethe).\nUkuze uzikhethele yona, qala ukudlala, bese usebenzisa inkinobho yesikrini esigcwele ezansi kwesokudla kwesidlali → igiya → Ikhwalithi (into yekhwalithi ayiveli ngaphambi kokuqala ukudlala).
Dlala elandelayo ngokuzenzakalelayo uma ividiyo iphela
Uma ividiyo iphela, kuyama bese kubonisa inkinobho ethi “Dlala ividiyo elandelayo”
Uma ividiyo iphela, kudlala kuphela ividiyo elandelayo kulolu hlu
Kulondolozwa ngokuzenzakalelayo njengoba uthayipha. Thepha kwenye indawo noma ku-“Kwenziwe” ukuze uqede ukuhlela.
Ibuyela kuvidiyo yokuqala ngemuva kweyokugcina (uma ukudlala okuzenzakalelayo kuvuliwe).
Amavidiyo amakwe ukuthi ayeqwe ayadlulwa ngesikhathi sokudlala okuzenzakalelayo.
Namavidiyo asebukiwe ayeqwa, ngakho kudlala angabukiwe kuphela.
Nge-Pro ungalondoloza iziteshi eziningi ze-YouTube futhi ulandelele inqubekelaphambili yesiteshi ngasinye.
Kurekhodwa kuphela okukhethile, ngaphandle kokuveza ubuwena.

Inguqulo yamahhala ikuvumela ukuthi usebenzise isiteshi esisodwa. Khetha isiteshi ofuna ukuqhubeka usisebenzisa mahhala. Iziteshi ezikhiyiwe zigcina umlando wokubuka, inqubekelaphambili, namanothi. Thenga i-Pro futhi ukuze usebenzise zonke iziteshi.
Ukuthenga kanye kuphela. Inguqulo yamahhala ilondoloza isiteshi esisodwa.
Asikwazanga ukufinyelela ku-Google Play. Sicela uzame futhi emuva kwesikhashana.
Inguqulo yamahhala ikuvumela ukuthi ulondoloze isiteshi esisodwa.

Ngaphakathi kwesiteshi sakho esilondoloziwe konke kusebenza ngaphandle komkhawulo: ukuhlela okudala noma okusha kuqala, ukulandelela okubukiwe, ukuqhubeka, izinkinobho zokweqa, amanothi, inqubekelaphambili, nokudlala esidlalini esisemthethweni.
Ukuthenga kanye okuvula ukulondoloza iziteshi eziningi.
Uma ufuna ukugcina umlando weziteshi eziningana, sebenzisa i-Pro.
Ukushintsha lesi siteshi kususa umlando wokubuka, inqubekelaphambili, namanothi esiteshi esilondoloziwe manje esithi “%s”.
Inguqulo yamahhala ikuvumela ukuthi usebenzise isiteshi esisodwa. Ukushintshela ku-“%1$s” kwenza ukuthi “%2$s” singatholakali. Awekho amarekhodi esiteshi nasiphi asuswayo.
Thenga i-Pro ukuze usebenzise futhi zonke iziteshi ezilondoloziwe, namarekhodi onke ephelele.
Lesi siteshi sikhiyiwe. I-Pro ayisasebenzi, ngakho inguqulo yamahhala ivumela isiteshi esisodwa. Thenga i-Pro futhi ukuze uqhubeke nomlando wakho wokubuka, inqubekelaphambili, namanothi ephelele.
Inkokhelo yakho isalindile. I-Pro izovuleka ngokuzenzakalelayo uma isiqediwe.

Londoloza iziteshi eziningi, landelela inqubekelaphambili yesiteshi ngasinye, futhi uphathe uhlu lwakho olulondoloziwe. Awudingi neze ukushintsha isiteshi, ngakho umlando wokubuka, inqubekelaphambili, namanothi akusoze kwasulwa. Izici zokuphatha ezithuthukile zesikhathi esizayo nazo zifakiwe.
Uma nje usebenzisa i-akhawunti ye-Google efanayo, ungakubuyisela ngemuva kokufaka kabusha noma ukushintsha idivayisi.
Akukho kuthenga okutholakele kule akhawunti ye-Google.
Izithombe-skrini zisebenzisa isiteshi somphakathi se-NASA njengesibonelo. Le app ayihlangene, ayigunyazwanga, futhi ayixhaswanga yi-YouTube noma i-NASA.
Ku-app ye-YouTube, vula ividiyo evela esiteshini ofuna ukusengeza, noma ikhasi lesiteshi uqobo.
Thepha okuthi Yabelana ngaphansi kwevidiyo, noma kumenyu ekhasini lesiteshi.
Khetha %s ohlwini lwama-app. Uma ungayiboni, vula okuthi “Okuningi”.
Amavidiyo esiteshi avuleka ngokushesha, okudala kuqala, elungele ukubukwa ngokulandelana.
